## 📰 Article

The 2025 Pulitzer Prize winners were officially announced on Monday, recognizing several major American news organizations for their outstanding coverage of significant events.

The New York Times won three awards this year, including the editorial writing category. The paper has maintained its leading position in deep reporting and commentary, with its investigative journalism and editorial pages once again earning the jury's recognition.

The Associated Press received the international reporting award, honoring its timely and accurate coverage of major global events. Over the past year, AP correspondents filed high-quality reports from conflict zones, natural disaster sites, and political upheaval, demonstrating the vital role of international news networks.

The Washington Post and the Minnesota Star Tribune were also recognized. The Star Tribune won for its breaking news coverage, earning national recognition for its commitment to community journalism in Minnesota. The Washington Post received nominations across several categories and ultimately secured wins.

The Pulitzer Prize is the most prestigious award in American journalism, administered annually by the Pulitzer Prize Board at Columbia University. It honors excellence in journalism, literature, and musical composition. This year's winners reaffirm the enduring importance of traditional news media in the digital age.
